title: Cadmatic workflows and connector status
description: Explore Cadmatic workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Cadmatic

Cadmatic

CADMATIC supports ship and plant design with hull, outfitting and production-information workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Develop a hull structure

Start from the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended Cadmatic preview, develop a hull structure; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate marine outfitting

Begin with the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended Cadmatic preview, coordinate marine outfitting; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Issue production information

Use the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended Cadmatic preview, issue production information; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
